notes: GASTAT (Saudi Arabia's statistics authority) publishes population only at governorate level, not by any finer sub-city unit — Riyadh Governorate's entire 2022 census population is applied as a single figure covering the whole map. Because a literal single mega-district breaks distance-decay in the gravity model (residents and jobs would be equally likely to be matched regardless of actual distance), the governorate was re-split into a synthetic ~5km regular grid after the fact, weighted by building floor area per cell — this grid is our own construction, not a real sub-governorate statistical unit, so it does not raise the granularity answer above governorate-level. No real employment data exists: jobs are a flat 40% of resident population, redistributed across OSM buildings weighted by floor area only. Commute flows are an unconstrained gravity model with no real O/D anchor.
sources: https://www.stats.gov.sa/en (GASTAT, General Authority for Statistics — 2022 mid-year population by administrative region)
